title: Meta says hackers stole some code and personal data of roughly 1,500 people, most of them employees in the US, after compromising some of its GitHub repos (Eduard Kovacs/SecurityWeek)
summary: Eduard Kovacs / SecurityWeek: Meta says hackers stole some code and personal data of roughly 1,500 people, most of them employees in the US, after compromising some of its GitHub repos — Most of the affected individuals are Meta employees in the United States and they are being offered credit monitoring services.
